chapter: A New Day at the Lil' Fungi Playground
act_title: A New Day at the Lil' Fungi Playground

quests.title: A New Day at the Lil' Fungi Playground

dialogue.t: Haniyyah, Souka, we're back!
I could already hear Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy's cheerful steps from a distance. Looks like you really had a blast this time!
You can tell they're having fun from that far away? I still can't read the emotions in our Fungi friends' footsteps...
Guess I've got a lot to learn... There's always more to learn!
Hehe, this trip really did feel different!
Running around with our Fungi friends, then coming back to the Lil' Fungi Playground, it feels like coming home to a nice meal after a long day of playing outside.
How about we take a photo together right now? Paimon remembers reading in The Steambird that many famous travel journals line up all the little snapshots from a trip in chronological order.
Now that Silver Companion mentions it, I've gotten so used to having these Fungi friends around all these years... We've never really taken a proper photo together...
Mmhmm! You two big shots really know how to wrap up an adventure nicely!
Alright, let's use Bongo-Head's Kamera, set it on the tripod, and take a timed group photo!
Once Haniyyah and Souka are less busy, we can all go out and have fun together like this again!
Yippee!
Speaking of which, Bongo-Head is really talented at taking photos!
Paimon picked a few good shots and put them together with our group photo. Haniyyah and Souka can check them out too!

dialogue.sit: Wow... you really thought of everything...

dialogue.t: Oh, and... Paimon brought some souvenirs for you.
Here! The macarons you didn't get to try before!
Aww, I only said it in passing, and you actually remembered it?
Silver Companion... I'm so touched...
To avoid troubling you like this in the future, I really need to fix my bad habits. I'll plan trips properly in advance... and not just on paper.
You know, when friends are hanging out and chatting freely, even offhand comments can show what's truly on your mind.
Oh, back when we were taking photos in Fontaine.
While you were watching the scenery with Bongo-Head, Paimon got a newsy to help out and gave her a little tip for the trouble.
Don't worry, Paimon prepared your share too! Paimon wouldn't forget, hehe.
Paimon even reminded the newsy to go straight for your favorite flavor as soon as she got inside!
But we've already tried almost every dessert in Fontaine, so Paimon's not sure how much of a surprise this will actually be...

dialogue.sit: Anything Paimon picks out is bound to be delicious.
It's a treat you bought for me on your own. That makes it special!

dialogue.t: Really? Hehe... then Paimon will buy you treats more often!
Too bad there aren't any sweets made especially for our Fungi friends... How amazing would it be if we could cuddle up with them and enjoy a table full of delicious food!
No need to worry about that. In the process of refining On Fungi Communities, I've been conducting foundational research on the food that Fungi enjoy.
My goal is to identify ingredients that both Fungi and humans can eat, so our buddies don't have to live off every flavor of Marvelous Jelly all year long.
One day, I'll find the ingredients that satisfy both human and Fungi tastes, and design delicious dishes we can all enjoy together!
And when it comes to putting theory into practice, I'll be our master chef! Just in case Haniyyah ends up ruining our eleventh pot.
Sounds like the day we sit in a circle and share a meal with our Fungi friends isn't far off, right?

dialogue.sit: We'll be waiting for your good news, Haniyyah!
We can't wait for Souka's feast!

dialogue.t: In that case, please do come back and visit the Lil' Fungi Playground when you get the chance. We, and all our Fungi friends, will always be here.
Who knows? The surprise might arrive even sooner than you expect.

quests.description: After several days of travel and fun, you return to the Lil’ Fungi Playground at Bayda Harbor, accompanied by your Fungi friends…
